import subprocess, sys, resource, time, os
inp = open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=inp, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
el=time.time()-t0
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('elapsed %.1fs maxrss %.0f MiB rc=%d outbytes=%d err=%s' % (el, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, p.returncode, len(p.stdout or b''), p.stderr[:300]))
